book.name: Apanll Chtarangu
book.title: Apanll chtarangu anu Apanll chtakchuri ashirangu anu

content: Na, yuwaatssha Sekem Dinaa yutarit patatarangu anootssha kamanchintspa
Dina mang, Liycha wipaya. Waparshat Akopcha. Anshat Din kamasinayaru, yaktashuchpa kamasinpatatin ipunpi átu, xiyrangiya.

Kanungassha anush yakat taarangiya, suru Sekema, Hamorcha wipaya. Hamor anpur anush yakat kurakamuna Hebewchich tputsi. Anoo yaktaa ksutarangiya. Ashirucha, Sekemsha Dinaa pakeeru, putarangiya. Nduntaa Din zandarangu, ashiritaa, pshiyreeru, mantsir patatarangiya.
Kanungassha Dinangaz kapung zandarangu, Din nuwaa chinapanda átu, Dinaa zapan izamzaztar ashirangiya.
Sekemsha waparee Hamoraa tsiyatku, tárangiya; Apaa, nuwaam mashanda. Nuw izanlleemi yamaamamaricha. Nee kiz zandki, tárangiya wapareetsi.

Akopsha anoo k'kuz mazinarangiya, yuwaa Sekem wipaa Dinaa mantsir patatku anootsi. Itaru, wipsha ashpari apusap pastup chinuzip taárash shanee ashiranganaya. Akopsha wipaa kutaku, natumasam nda tsiyatarangiya.
Itaru, ndaturi wip kusarusin, Sekemsha wapar kizaa mashpi átu, Akopash naparangiya. Itaru, Akopsha: Xamachi. Ipari ichingaru kuseemasa, tárangiya.

Ashiriya, zapishsha ashpari wip pangusish kusateeramchusin, anush tsiyatssee yuwaa Sekem wizaree yutarit patatarangu anoo mazinaranganaya. Mazinarangusin, ashpari Akop wip kapung tsiyantaranganaya. ¿Mayaamshitaja Sekem apapaa yutaritash wayamaam zandak? Iyaatstam yutaritam ínaranganawa, táranganaya.
Itaru, Hamorsha; Nuw ipari siyaa izarish zandkiya. Ashirucha, nuwsha siyaa táshina: Waanari ashiru, izarish ipareemi panamaam waritakinaariya, watam nuw ipari kanungas taakuwa.
Ashirucha, ipareemi panakchus, siysa iyachchee nutsas yamachtamsa. Siyashuch kamuzanur iyaa iparni yamachinllinaya. Ambinaapa sheeruch kis taachchee.
Siy nishurtatam tsap taarasheemis saamataritam tsapunis yachtamsa. Washunandarisha yapandayaruch taachchee. Sheernapsa, nishurisha tsap taatssa; tsapuneemaritamtis paxanxatssa, tárangiya Hamorarini.
Ántaru, wipshat Sekem Dinaa wapar, wayucheetstam tsiyatarangiya. Mashku; Nuwaam izanlli iparish kasanganda. Waanari iparish nuwaam panatarush, nuw shiyaam istachinlla.

Ipareetsish yamatarinaareena, uru nuw maachiritaatsi siyaam mangutariti panamaam taariya. Maachi aranginasha zapan siyaam panachintspa. Ashirucha, nuwaam iparish pananda atashina, tárangiya Sekemsha tsiyatku.
Sekem Akopaa wip Dinaa mantsir patatarangu, itaru wayuchtisin, Akopsha wip tsiyataranganaya. Mangu Sekemaa tamapingaranganaya.
Zuraktishcha. Itaru, iyashuch tputs kamuz yuwaam nda wayumshiri tas nllurtama nda ktsuparangu anoom ¿nitaati iy izareetsini panatareezini? Iy amb ashimaam paziktanicha.

Ashirucha, anumun nuw siyaam izareetsi panamaam pachindakpazi ashkina, watam iy nllitaritamaniwa. Nuwsha siyaa táshina; wandaya iyapa taamaam zandkus, ashiri ashparitis tputs kamuzaw kanungaseew taarana, anoo ashpari wayumshiree tas ktsupchinllinpa.

Ambinaapari sheerus, uru iyaa izarini yamatartatssa. Iyshat kamuzanurini siyachchee izaris yamachtamaniya. Siyashuch kanungas iyaa izarni yamakatarusin, iyshat siyashchee kizanurnis yamakatpitamaniya. Ambinaapa sheeruch, washunandarisha yapandachchee. Washunandarisha yakat kayaneeruch taachchee.

Itaru, yuwaa áti anoo nduniya, ayu, átus, nda siyashuch nuwaa kuki nda payuksin, kamuzanur wayumshiree tas nda ktsupkusin, uru iy nee yakat shitungeeruni, arapsha naachiniya, Akoparinshitisin wip táranganaya.
Ashirucha, Hamorsha, anuritam mang chinaranganaya wipaptarta Sekempatarta. Ashiriya, amb sheeni, táranganaya.
Ashirucha, Sekem nda pakchiyam xararangiya, watam Akopaa wip Dinaa kapung zandaranguwa. Akoparini wip tárangana anoo kuk payurangu, anuritam tuminurangiya.
Ashirucha, waparpat yuwash tputs paxanxamaam shaniykana anshutam kamankatu naatarangiya. Kamanku tárangiya;

In tputs wanasircha. Amikurtamaam iyapat zandkanaya. ¿Ndushat nish ishinanda át? Iyashuch kamuzanur waa wizanur yamachinllinaya. Uwshtisin kamuzanur iyashchee kizanur uru yamachtamsinaya. Ashiriya, amb sheeruni, washunandarisha yapandayaruni taayani. Watam tsap kapung kureeruwa. Waani watsapuneem paxanxeersin taachtamsinaya.
Iyshat ashparitini kamuzanuri mshirni tas ktsupeeni, watam uwshtisin anuritam payukanawa. Iyshat sheertamani washunandarisha kis taapani. Waani iyash tsapuni taapana.
Amb ashkatssin, uru iyshat wakararineetsini yamachtamaniya. Ashpari chinoo iyshat amuytachiniya. Maachtaw payukana anuwa ashpari iyamari amuytachiniya, mang táranganaya.

Ashiriya, yaktashuchshat kamuzanur kanungaseewtam, Ayu, tárangusin, ashparitssin zamangaranganaya. Ashiri pza. Amb sheeni Hamor tánna anootsi, tárangusin, ashparitssin wayumshiree tas ktsuparanganaya.

Tuchpashsha zar Akop wip Simeón, Leviy ashirusin, Dinanandari wayuch: Pzaya, pangaani yaktapi, táranganaya. Anshuchshitisin yaktashuch yuw wayumshiree tas ktsupeerna an kizpur ksurangiya; chiyzamaam nda waritarangusin, wasurimun tamurutar ashiranganaya. Nda waanaatsi tapachindamaam nda waritaranganaya. Akopsha wip machtaree yátartaranganaya. Sheersin, kamuzanuree kachingaranganaya.
Hamorashshat pang' pshtuyarusin, mchitpa pacharangitamsinaya wipaptari Sekempatarta. Sheersin, Sekemash pangu wizaree yanpuranganaya. Sheerandsin, wapitam wapariptam pang' kanapuranganaya.

Zoonllshtisin kuzizimun káyashinusin, yaktash kusarangtamsina. Tsiparimunsha iwaz kata kata sheersin, maachiritawa ashpari ichingaranganaya. Maachtawaatstam, chinuzeewaatstam ichingaru machtarangana. Wizaree Dina Sekem mantsir patatarangu anumand tsiyantayarusin ashiranganaya.
Ashchiri yaktash shuchiranganaya; wakaraatstam, opeejaatstam, burrootstam, ichingaru yaktashuch payurana anoo ashpari shuchiranganaya.
Nllurawaatstam ashpari yamaranganaya, kizawaatstamta.

Ashiriya Akopsha mang tsimbunuri wipaa Simeóna, Leviyaa ashiru kuruzeeru, ¿Mang, siy tputsee pacharangis? ¿Ndushta anumand nuwaatsshat tputs natsaychinda, Kanaanshuchshitisina, Feresewshuchtamta? Anshuchshitisin uru nuwaa kapung natsachinllinaya. Watam wazapanshitisinawa. Iyshat tputsirini pakchim kamuzanurni taariniya. Uru iyaatsim pachachinllinaya, zuwanlleewaatstamti uru pachachtamsinaya, mang wipaa tárangiya.
Itaru wipshitisin: ¿Antaati iy izarni mshipaneeja? Anumand nuw nda mbizamaam zandkiniya, mang waparee táranganaya. Ashiriya, na kamaneena yuwaa Akopaa wip Dina Sekem mantsir patatarangu anootsi.
